competitors.name: Associated Wholesale Grocers / Crav'n Flavor
competitors.action: AWG Family of Brands said its Q2 2026 private-brand expansion adds 64 items, including 16 Crav'n Flavor frozen pizzas across rising, thin and stuffed-crust varieties. AWG said the items are available to member retailers now and will appear on shelves through the summer.

competitors.name: Food manufacturers / GLP-1 shoppers
competitors.action: Food Business News reported IFT FIRST panelists saying GLP-1 adoption is pushing manufacturers to renovate familiar products around benefit stacking, especially protein and fiber, while keeping taste and smaller portions central to repeat purchase.

competitors.name: U.S. grocery retailers and CPG brands
competitors.action: Supermarket News reported Acosta Group's new Affordability Tracker showing grocery purchasing power has improved since 2023, but price scrutiny, promotion seeking and value comparison remain durable shopper behaviors after inflation.

trends.magnitude: AWG added 16 Crav'n Flavor frozen pizza SKUs in Q2 2026
trends.context: Independent and regional grocers are getting more store-brand frozen pizza options from scaled wholesalers, increasing pressure on emerging premium brands to prove velocity and distinctiveness against value-led private label.

trends.magnitude: Circana cited 15% of Americans now on a GLP-1 drug; Morgan Stanley projects 55M U.S. users by 2035
trends.context: Frozen and bakery-adjacent brands should expect more buyer attention on protein, fiber, portion size and taste credibility. Real Dough's quality cues need to coexist with a practical nutrition and serving-size story.

trends.magnitude: Acosta's 84-item typical stock-up trip costs more than $366, about 27% above 2020
trends.context: Even as purchasing power improves, shoppers are still comparing alternatives and chasing promotions. Premium frozen pizza sell-in should emphasize clear meal value, repeat purchase and promotion discipline rather than relying on category recovery alone.

Grocery affordability improves but inflation has changed consumer behavior for good
